messages.en:
Hey, I moved! Yeah, sorry
for not telling you where
I'm going, but you'll just
cry or something.

Due to circumstances out
of my control, I had to
move. Yeah, I know. Lame.
Now STOP CRYING! Geez!

So I packed up and moved
the other day. Don't take
it too personally... Most
of it wasn't your fault.

Finally! I picked up and
left {04 11 00}! I was so
tired of this stink hole!
Anyway, come visit, OK?

I moved. Yep. Moved. Gone.
Huh? Oh, come on! Stop
crying! STOP IT! We'll meet
again... Probably.
